title: PostgreSQL index methods and operators
brief: Choose a PostgreSQL access method and operator class from the operator’s meaning and data organisation. Compare B-tree, hash, GIN, GiST, SP-GiST and BRIN, and verify candidates, rechecks and write costs in native plans.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-schema-change: Owns concurrent builds, invalid indexes and native maintenance procedures.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-text: Owns linguistic text retrieval and ranking.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-extensions: Owns specialised type and extension dependencies.

title: Full-text search in PostgreSQL
brief: Build text retrieval from tokens, phrases and configuration through ranked, filtered results. Keep indexed candidate retrieval, linguistic matching and relevance evaluation distinct, including maintenance when source text or configuration changes.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-vector: Owns embedding-vector retrieval; text relevance is not nearest-neighbour recall.

title: Types and extensions in PostgreSQL
topic: PostgreSQL specialised types and extension lifecycle
brief: Express overlap and spatial predicates with suitable types, operators and indexes. Own extension installation, privileges, dependencies, restore, upgrade and removal, including when an extension becomes part of the application’s durability contract.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-vector: Owns complete vector retrieval and evaluation.
